page.layout: One page of running text. Running head with page number at the top. Marginal notes in the left margin beside the second paragraph and beside the precept heading.

main_text.p: poftea vero cum liberalius bibunt, atĉius validiusq;: quem morem Scythis etiam fuiffe in bello, vt diutius & conftantius famem tolerarent; graues autores tradiderunt. Noftræ, ne mentem animumq; vinum nimium obtundat atq; etiam adimat, ciborum luxuriæ vnâ vacant, plurisvinolentiam, quàm opes facientes.

Tres fo- mina uno [?] [illegible, ~4 letters] 15 men- furas no- strates epo tarunt.Non poffum filentio hic præterire memorabilem bibacitatem, quâ apud nos tres mulieres ciuicæ fe nobilitarunt, vno prandio quindecim menfuras vini ciuiles in ventrem abfumentes, constante adhuc mente & animo, vt ita in totum dixiffe liceat, fœminarum genus vini auidissimum effe.
Sed ceffo ne infanis illis Bacchis fiam Archilochicus.

head.i: Sequitur præceptio II. de tempore cibum fumendi: differ corpus reficiendi: Non vefcendum prius quàm appetitus & fames adfit.

main_text.p: Prec. 2. De tempore re cibum fumendi.Non intelligo hic famem morbosam, quæ cibum expetit corpore non indigente. Præsente igitur fame cibus non est protrahendus, juxta illud vulgatum: Non toleranda fames nam ventrem humoribus implet;

page.notes: The left-margin notes are small and partly unclear; their wording is a best reading. The first letter of the paragraph "Non intelligo" is a large initial, read as N. The page number is printed as "6z" and is read as 62. The catchword "Ventri-" sits at the lower right. The text "nos tres" is printed with a space and is copied as printed.
